name: Owens Community College
oos_note: Public JUCO. Non-resident (out-of-state) tuition & fees, Fall 2026 rate schedule from owens.edu tuition-rates page: full-time (12-18 cr/semester) Out-of-State Instructional Fee $5,530 + Out-of-State General Fee $434 = $5,964/semester; annual (Fall+Spring, 2 semesters) = $11,928. Matches basis of in-state figure (in-state full-time $2,765+$217=$2,982/sem x2=$5,964/yr, ~consistent with published in-state $5,870). Excludes housing/optional fees.
